verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator, so storing and syncing passkeys is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack only shows cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted sync of TOTP/HOTP codes. The one passkey mention refers to Ente supporting passkeys as a way to log into the user's own Ente account, not to storing or syncing the user's passkeys for other services, so it is not credited.
